name: OAuth
attack_surface: Authorization redirect URLs, client secrets, state parameters, authorization codes, access tokens
common_misconfigurations: Lack of validation on redirect_uri allowing open redirect to external hosts
Missing state parameter resulting in CSRF vulnerabilities on authentication
Leakage of client secrets in client-side script code definitions
validation_methods: Test state parameter omission during authentication flow
Tamper redirect_uri parameter to target external listener domains
evidence_requirements: Raw HTTP requests tracking redirect behavior to external address
Session trace proving successful takeover using CSRF link click
false_positive_indicators: System rejecting tampered parameters on subsequent API authorization code requests
Redirect URLs matching predefined whitelist values only
reporting_guidance: High priority focus area. Redirect validation flaws leading to account takeover are critical severity.
